pages.title: Wheels and stickers · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday afternoon at a busy skate park in Los Angeles. Wheels roll and boards clack on the concrete. Teo walks in with a skateboard under his arm. He watches a teenager jump over a small rail. A friendly skater named Max waves at him. His helmet is covered in stickers.
“Hey! Do you skate or ride a scooter?” says Max. “I skate. I prefer a skateboard to a scooter.” says Teo. “Cool. I prefer the bowl, but the rail is harder.” says Max.
